info.title: Dahae API
info.summary: Customer, partner (pro), member and staff API. Versioning and deprecation: docs/api/README.md.
info.description: All business routes live under /v1 (health and app-links at the root). Errors use the envelope {"error":{"code":"<stable_code>","message":"<optional>"}}. Lists are cursor-paginated where marked: pass the X-Next-Cursor response header back as `cursor`. Business dates are Korean dates (KST); timestamps are RFC 3339 in UTC.

code.description: Stable machine code; clients branch on this, never on message text.

message.description: Optional human text. Never contains internals.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Page size, 1 to 100 (default 50). Out of range is 400 invalid_limit.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque; the X-Next-Cursor value of the previous page. Malformed is 400 invalid_cursor.

Before.name: before
Before.description: created_at (RFC 3339) of the oldest message already shown.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Retrying with the same key and body replays the first response for 24 hours (header Idempotent-Replayed: true). The same key with a different body is 400 idempotency_key_reused. A request still running is 409 idempotency_in_progress.

NextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page. Absent on the last page.

schema.description: Shape documented per route in the handler's request type; unknown fields are rejected on staff routes.

Error.description: Error envelope. Codes are stable; see docs/api/README.md for the list of common codes.
